verdict.rationale: Deel documents an official MCP server that exposes platform operations (contracts, people, payroll, time) as agent-invokable tools, with a tools reference (e.g. listOfContracts, createTimeOffRequest), HTTP-transport compatibility, and OAuth2 flows handled automatically by Cursor, VS Code, Claude Desktop and ChatGPT; a probe confirms the docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually connecting and using the server.
